title: The Windmill Hole Sabotage
intro: Someone has sabotaged the indoor mini-golf tournament by swapping the course's scorecards and slipping gummy worms into the hole cups.

suspects.name: Kenji
suspects.line: Popcorn? Nope, I was too focused on my score.

suspects.name: Oona
suspects.line: I just came for the free lemonade.

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: My hands are spotless. Check them again.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I was only holding my putter, I swear it.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was busy cheering from the bench.

clues.text: The popcorn bucket by the snack stand is still full and untouched. Whoever ate during the sabotage was definitely not eating popcorn.
A red beanie was found hanging neatly on the coat rack, with no one wearing it nearby. The culprit was not wearing a red beanie.
Sticky gummy-sticky fingers left smudges all over the swapped scorecards. Whoever touched these had gummy-sticky fingers.
A half-empty orange soda was found tucked under a bench near the windmill. Someone here was drinking orange soda during the mix-up.
